_comment: Codex line shown after a level, keyed by concept id. Draft text: the tunnel line is scheduled for a physics fix (todo.md §2 / S4).

lines.tunnel: “Enough energy, and even a wall isn't really a wall any more.”
lines.superposition: “You followed both paths at once, until I looked... and one of them became real.”
lines.intrication: “Pull the lever here, and over there, far away, something moves. Nobody really knows why it's that fast.”
lines.incertitude: “The more exactly you aim, the less you know how fast you'll go. That's the price of being precise.”
lines.quantification: “No smooth dial here: only a few possible energy notches, no more, no less.”
lines.spin: “Your spin decides who pulls you in and who pushes you away — an invisible compass.”
lines.dualite: “Wave or particle? Today, you chose to slip through like a wave.”
